purpose: Provide explicit contextual dimensions for cross-civilizational pattern analysis without collapsing association into causation, culture into ancestry, or observed practice into private belief.
unit_rule: Every value must retain its original unit of observation, time interval, geography, source, coding rule and uncertainty. Society-level values must not be projected onto individuals.

dimensions.label: Demography and population
guards: population estimates are uncertain
aggregate values do not describe every individual

dimensions.label: Kinship and household organization
guards: co-burial does not establish biological kinship
biological kinship does not exhaust social kinship

dimensions.label: Subsistence and food systems
guards: subsistence similarity does not imply common origin

dimensions.label: Economy and production
guards: material wealth is not a direct measure of wellbeing

dimensions.label: Trade and exchange
guards: object movement does not prove person movement
similar objects do not by themselves prove contact

dimensions.label: Settlement and urbanism
guards: settlement scale is not a scalar measure of social complexity

dimensions.label: Governance and political organization
guards: institutional labels must retain source-specific definitions

dimensions.label: Law, norms and social control
guards: reported rule does not prove compliance
supernatural sanction and secular sanction are separate dimensions

dimensions.label: Status and inequality
guards: grave wealth does not uniquely identify lifetime rank

dimensions.label: Conflict and warfare
guards: trauma does not identify attacker
weapon presence does not prove warrior identity

dimensions.label: Technology and material systems
guards: technology similarity does not imply diffusion
complexity is multidimensional rather than a single ladder

dimensions.label: Mobility and migration
guards: isotopic non-locality is not identical to migration
cultural change does not imply population replacement

dimensions.label: Population history and ancestry
guards: genetic ancestry does not determine cultural identity
ghost ancestry cannot be assigned to a named fossil taxon without independent evidence

dimensions.label: Language and communication
guards: linguistic similarity does not by itself establish borrowing or descent
writing is not equivalent to language

dimensions.label: Environment and climate
guards: environmental correlation does not prove environmental causation

dimensions.label: Health, disease and nutrition
guards: skeletal or molecular markers require preservation and sampling models
historical observations do not license modern psychiatric diagnosis

dimensions.label: Cognition, learning and memory
guards: modern experiments are comparative evidence, not direct access to ancient minds
cognitive difference is not a hierarchy of intelligence

dimensions.label: Ritualized practice
guards: practice does not prove private belief
ritual does not have one universal function

dimensions.label: Supernatural agents and cosmology
guards: agent categories must preserve emic distinctions
similar agents do not imply shared origin

dimensions.label: Myth, narrative and oral tradition
guards: motif resemblance is hypothesis-generating only
recorded text may postdate oral traditions by an unknown interval

dimensions.label: Divination, magic and uncertainty practices
guards: practice is distinct from propositional belief
modern category labels may not match local categories

dimensions.label: Altered states and induction
guards: exposure does not establish ritual use
phenomenological resemblance does not prove common mechanism or historical continuity

dimensions.label: Mortuary and ancestor-related practice
guards: human remains in an unusual context do not automatically indicate ritual deposition
burial form does not uniquely identify belief

dimensions.label: Symbolic, graphic and representational behavior
guards: anthropogenic modification does not automatically establish semantics
pigment may have production or perceptual functions

dimensions.label: Institutions and collective organization
guards: institutional presence does not imply uniform participation or belief

dimensions.label: Intergroup contact and network position
guards: contact makes transmission possible but does not prove transmission

cross_dimension_rules: No single dimension is a civilization score.
Missing values remain unknown and are never converted to absent.
Correlation requires matched units, chronology and geography plus explicit confounder review.
Directional claims require temporal ordering and competing mechanisms.
Phylogenetic, spatial and source dependence must be modeled when relevant.
Patterns may be descriptive, associational or causal candidates; only domain-appropriate identification strategies can support causal claims.
